hypotheses.name: Triangle-defect hard-null robustness expansion
hypotheses.method: Across immune/lung/external_lung and seeds 42/43/44 on source/target-disjoint splits and layers {7,11}, reran H69 triangle-defect scoring (k={8,12,16}) with 48 permutations per null family (endpoint swap, matched random third node, label permutation) and bootstrap CIs on domain-split means.
hypotheses.result_value: mean delta AUROC=+0.02637 (std 0.02687); positive rows 29/36; p_best<0.05 in 36/36; mean matched-random-third null-gap q95=+0.01010; positive mean domain-splits 6/6
hypotheses.next_action: Run a confirmatory pass with stronger biological/coexpression controls and stress-test the weaker immune slices.

hypotheses.name: Cross-model topology-signature distillation transfer
hypotheses.method: Seed42 held-out-domain pilot on immune/lung/external_lung with source/target-disjoint splits and layers {7,11}; trained weighted ridge distillation maps from Geneformer signatures to scGPT topology signatures on two source domains, then evaluated held-out transfer utility against Geneformer baseline with random teacher-signature assignment, anchor-label shuffle, and signature-destroy controls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean delta AUROC=-0.42758 (std 0.17687); positive rows 0/12; mean null_gap_q95=-0.14795; mean mapped-to-sc cosine=+0.00634
hypotheses.next_action: Retire this cross-model transfer endpoint for the current loop and reallocate budget to non-retired families.
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Second major-change rescue still produced strongly negative transfer utility and negative null-gap across held-out domains.

hypotheses.name: Edge trajectory motif class scan
hypotheses.method: Seed42 pilot across immune/lung/external_lung and source/target-disjoint splits; built edge trajectory features across layers {0,3,7,11}, clustered into motif classes, and tested motif-augmented scoring against baseline under layer-order permutation and degree-bin motif-label shuffle controls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean delta AUROC=+0.00008 (std 0.00593); positive rows 4/6 but p_best<0.05 in 0/6; enrichment p<0.05 in 0/6
hypotheses.next_action: If retained for one more pass, increase null permutations and add multiseed coverage; otherwise retire as low-yield.
